sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Greedy Gnomes is a game about strategy and wit. Players take on the role of Us and Zus, two wealthy gnomes who are engaged in a game of wits, using rubies and diamonds as pawns. The goal is simple: be the first player to collect all the rubies and diamonds on the board. Sounds easy, right? Wrong! The gameplay is deceptively simple, but it's the strategic depth that makes Greedy Gnomes truly challenging.

The game is played on a grid-based board, with each player having a set of rubies and diamonds to use. Players can move their pawns around the board, trying to collect the rubies and diamonds while blocking their opponent's moves. The twist? Each pawn has a unique ability, such as swapping places with another pawn or moving extra spaces. This adds a whole new level of strategy to the game, as players need to think carefully about which pawns to use and when.

Despite its simple gameplay, Greedy Gnomes requires a combination of luck, strategy, and wit to win.
